public_rationale: LionTree reported in February 2026 that NVIDIA shares had been stuck in a trading range since November. That supports the narrow prediction that investor momentum would slow. Zitron explicitly allowed sentiment to weaken without sales slowing. This does not establish his broader collapse scenario; NVIDIA subsequently reported strong revenue growth.
limitations: The result depends on interpreting momentum to include a sustained share-price plateau.
Neither a permanent downturn nor an AI collapse is established.
